hero_subtitle: Equip yourself with the knowledge to survive any disaster. From earthquakes to floods, learn the essential dos and don'ts before crisis strikes.
disaster_subtitle: Understand the different types of natural disasters and how they impact communities globally.
disaster_flood_desc: Overflow of water that submerges land that is usually dry.
disaster_cyclone_desc: A large scale air mass that rotates around a strong center of low atmospheric pressure.
disaster_earthquake_desc: A sudden and violent shaking of the ground, sometimes causing great destruction.
disaster_fire_desc: Rapid oxidation of a material in the exothermic chemical process of combustion.
guide_subtitle: Essential Do's and Don'ts to keep you and your loved ones safe before, during, and after a disaster.
about_desc_1: ResQNet is an AI-Powered Integrated Disaster Management & Emergency Response Platform. Our core mission is to bridge the gap between affected citizens, non-governmental organizations (NGOs), and government agencies during the most critical times of crisis.
about_together_desc: Our global network of volunteers and professionals works around the clock to ensure safety protocols are followed worldwide.
connect_subtitle: Join our unified ecosystem. Choose how you want to interact with the ResQNet platform.
ngo_card_desc: Join our verified network of disaster response organizations. Manage rescue missions, track resources, and coordinate with local authorities in real-time.
citizen_card_desc: Your personal safety companion. Send instant SOS alerts, receive live warnings, and navigate to the nearest safe zones offline.
footer_desc: An AI-powered integrated platform connecting citizens, NGOs, and government agencies for swift and effective disaster response.
